status: IN PROGRESS: seed 42 exploratory running; success rule predeclared below BEFORE seeds 43/44
script: scripts/postproc_readout.py (self-check PASS); runner scripts/run_jobs.sh; summary scripts/summarize.py
scope: Track A, dev cohorts only (HAM ham_dev, PAD pad_adapt). No holdout/target_test opened. CPU only. No labels in any transform.
label_free_rule: Every transform (center, power, block/group L2, PCA-whitening with fixed shrinkage) is fitted on the outer-train rows of each fold. Labels touch only the balanced LR and the C selection, as in the protocol. Inner-validation rows enter the unsupervised fit (their features, not labels); no test rows enter any fit.

protocol.readout: evaluate_overlay_readout protocol: row-L2 -> transform -> row-L2, balanced LR (class_weight=balanced, max_iter=2000), C by inner macro-F1 (argmax predictions), nested grouped folds outer 5 / inner 3, CV seeds 20261025/26/27

featuresets.v10-448-cls4_d4: variants s{seed}-r448 cls4_d4 (3072 dims, D4 TTA)
featuresets.v10-448-cls4patch: variants s{seed}-r448 cls4patch (6144 dims = CLS4 + per-layer patch MEAN). GeM NOT stored, not run (needs GPU re-extraction of patch tokens)

arms.raw: baseline: row-L2 only (must reproduce stored readouts)
arms.block: L2 per 768-dim layer block before concatenation (4 blocks for 3072-dim, 8 for cls4patch), then row-L2
arms.groupl2: cls4patch only: L2 on the CLS4 half and on the patch-mean half separately, then row-L2
arms.pcaw128/256/512: PCA whitening on outer-train rows, top k components, eigenvalues shrunk lambda' = 0.9 lambda + 0.1 mean(lambda), then row-L2
arms.pcaw_full: PCA whitening over the full outer-train span (rank = n_train). Not ZCA: the complement of the train span is dropped
arms.power_pcaw256: signed sqrt, then PCA whitening k=256 (shrink 0.1), then row-L2

predeclared_success_rule.R1_macro_f1: mean over the 3 CV seeds of delta macro-F1 vs raw (same encoder seed, same featureset) >= +0.005 in BOTH cohorts

R2_clinical_no_regression.PAD: MEL_recall delta >= -0.02 AND SCC_recall delta >= -0.02 AND SCC_to_BCC delta <= +0.02

predeclared_success_rule.seed42_gate: PhA and PhB on both cohorts (exploratory). Only gate-passing arms are sent to seeds 43/44
predeclared_success_rule.CONFIRMED: gate passes on every encoder seed (42, 43, 44) in both cohorts for the same arm and featureset
predeclared_success_rule.NOT_CONFIRMED: any other outcome, including a seed-42 pass that fails on 43 or 44
predeclared_success_rule.multiplicity: about 60 arm-featureset cells in seed 42 alone; any seed-42 pass is a candidate, not a finding; the 43/44 confirmation is the guard

seed42_exploratory.grid: 96 jobs = 5 featuresets x 2 cohorts x arms (10 for 3072-d, 8 for 6144-d cls4patch); all completed
